description: Metaobjects (custom content entries: size charts, ingredients, FAQs, team members) on the merchant's Shopify store. action definitions (the types and their fields), list (type), get (id), create (type, fields [{key, value}], handle, status active | draft), update (id, fields: only the keys passed, handle, status), delete (id).
